app.name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
app.one_liner: A DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal, engineered around prefix-cache stability to minimize token costs during long sessions.

screens.name: Terminal Interface
screens.purpose: Provide a CLI/TUI for interacting with the AI coding agent, supporting code proposals, skill execution, and session management.

rust_commands.name: apply_edit
rust_commands.purpose: Apply a proposed SEARCH/REPLACE code edit to disk after user confirmation.

rust_commands.name: execute_skill
rust_commands.purpose: Run a named skill with configurable iteration budget and autocomplete support.

rust_commands.name: start_new_session
rust_commands.purpose: Initiate a new conversation session without archiving the current one unnecessarily.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add session persistence and auto-scroll for desktop
week 1: Build CLI interface with /apply and /new commands
week 1: Implement core cache-first loop with DeepSeek integration
acceptance_tests: Agent achieves >99% cache hit rate on long-running session with DeepSeek v4-flash
Desktop client scrolls to latest message automatically
Proposed code edits remain unapplied until explicit /apply command
Skill execution respects per-skill max-iters frontmatter setting
User can start a new session via /new without unintended archiving suffixes
